title: 第1738章 盛典开始第1737章 帮你梳发
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
忆无情微微一怔，眼底掠过一抹无奈的笑意，轻轻颔首应声：“既如此，便多谢师尊了。”
“这种事，也需要谢吗？”
昭宁歪了歪脑袋，眸底浮起一丝纯粹的狐疑，清冷的眉眼间染着几分不解。
于她而言，为他费心、为他周全，皆是理所应当，从无需这般客套礼数。
“呃……出于礼貌嘛。”
忆无情抬手摸了摸下巴，略显无奈地解释。
“哦。”
昭宁了然点头，语气清淡却直白恳切，“不必对我礼貌。”
她待他，本就不同于旁人，世间凡俗礼数，在二人之间从不多余。
“呃……”
忆无情唇角微微一颤，被她直白纯粹的话语噎了一下，只得无奈妥协，
“行。”
……
一夜静谧流转，天光破晓，晨曦洒落永恒古星。
沉寂许久的古星彻底苏醒，骤然变得喧嚣热闹、盛况空前。
来自无上星域各方的顶尖势力高层尽数亲赴此地，无人敢怠慢半分，皆是整装肃容、躬身赴会。
为了这场盛典，永恒古星上下早已筹备许久，整颗星域灵气升腾、结界舒展，
每一处景致、每一方格局皆经过精心排布，处处透着盛大庄重的气息。
盛典主场悬浮于永恒净土之上，凌空而立、云海环绕，是特意开辟建造的专属盛会之地，恢弘壮阔，气度非凡。
场地中央是一片极为辽阔的空旷灵台，坦荡开阔，足以容纳万千修士同聚。

四周层层叠叠排布着精致雅座，宛若环形观礼台，供各方来宾落座观礼。
此番场地格局，与昔日命运古星的盛典形制大致相仿，却更显恢弘大气。
整片场地皆是苏钰可和雪夜亲自规划设计，格局开阔、排布规整，
早早便预判了此番盛会宾客云集的盛大场面，足以容纳各方强者，毫无局促。
浮空盛典入口处，人流络绎不绝，往来皆是星域名流、顶尖强者。
叶河端坐于入口外侧，一身华服衬得身姿挺拔，面上挂着恰到好处的得体笑意，待人接物尽显周到。
只是他目光时常不自觉游离，悄悄掠过往来容貌靓丽的女修，眼底藏着几分随性玩味的轻佻。
他并未刻意收敛气息，一身无上禁忌的磅礴修为浑然外放，恐怖的威压悄然漫开，席卷四方。
过往宾客皆心头巨震，满脸骇然。
谁也未曾料到，这般镇守盛典入口、负责迎宾值守之人，竟会是一位无上禁忌！
众人心中愈发敬畏，暗自感慨永恒古星底蕴之深、排场之大。
content_en:
Yi Qingqing was slightly startled, a helpless smile flashed across his eyes, and he nodded gently and said, "In that case, thank you Master."
"Do you need to thank me for this kind of thing?"
Zhao Ning tilted his head, a trace of pure suspicion appeared in his eyes, and his cold brows were stained with a bit of confusion.
For her, it was natural for her to worry about him and be thoughtful for him, and she never needed to be so polite.
"Uh... just out of politeness."
Yi Qingqing raised her hand and touched her chin, explaining helplessly.
"Oh."
Zhao Ning nodded in understanding, her tone was light but straightforward and sincere, "You don't have to be polite to me."
She treated him differently from others, and the common courtesy in the world was never superfluous between the two of them.
"Uh..."
The corners of Yi Qingqing's lips trembled slightly, and he choked on her straightforward and pure words, so he had no choice but to compromise.
"Okay."

The night passed quietly, the sky broke at dawn, and the morning light shone on the eternal ancient stars.
Gu Xing, who had been dormant for a long time, completely woke up and suddenly became noisy and lively with unprecedented grandeur.
All the top power officials from the Supreme Star Territory came here in person, and no one dared to neglect them. They all dressed up solemnly and attended the meeting in person.
For this grand ceremony, Eternal Ancient Star has been preparing for a long time. The spiritual energy of the entire star field is rising and the enchantment is stretched.
Every scene and every layout has been carefully arranged, exuding a grand and solemn atmosphere.
The main venue of the grand ceremony is suspended above the eternal pure land, standing high in the sky and surrounded by a sea of ​​clouds. It is a purpose-built and exclusive grand gathering place, magnificent and magnificent.
In the center of the venue is an extremely vast and empty spiritual platform, open and spacious enough to accommodate thousands of monks gathering together.
There are exquisite elegant seats arranged in layers around it, like a circular viewing platform, for guests from all walks of life to sit and watch the ceremony.
The layout of this venue is roughly similar to the grand ceremony of Destiny Ancient Star in the past, but it is even more grand and grand.
The entire venue was personally planned and designed by Su Yuke and Xue Ye, with an open layout and regular arrangement.
It was predicted early that the grand gathering of guests at this grand event would be enough to accommodate powerful people from all walks of life without being cramped.
At the entrance of the Floating Ceremony, there was an endless stream of people coming and going. They were all celebrities and top powerhouses from the star domain.
Ye He was sitting on the outside of the entrance. He was dressed tall and straight in his luxurious clothes. He had a decent smile on his face, showing his thoughtfulness in dealing with others.
It's just that his eyes often wander unconsciously, quietly passing by the beautiful female cultivators passing by, with a bit of casual and playful frivolity hidden in his eyes.
He did not deliberately restrain his aura, and the majestic cultivation of the supreme taboo was completely exposed, and the terrifying pressure quietly spread and swept across all directions.
The guests who passed by were all shocked and their faces were full of shock.
No one expected that the person who was guarding the entrance to the ceremony and was responsible for welcoming guests would actually be a supreme taboo!
Everyone became more and more awed, secretly sighing at the profound foundation and grandeur of the Eternal Ancient Star.
